svg.data-weight: 13 lb (5.9 kg) with no power supply and no fan module (guide Table 10, stated for every model but the 48MP); 16.1 lb (7.3 kg) with one power supply and two fan modules (datasheet)
svg.data-depth-no-psu: 454.0 mm (17.87 in, 45.4 cm) with no power supply or uplink module (Table 10)
svg.data-depth-with-uplink: 490.7 mm (19.31 in, 49.07 cm) with a power supply and an uplink module (Table 10)
svg.data-uplink-module-weight: 0.61 lb (0.28 kg) for the 2-port EX-UM-2QSFP; 0.74 lb (0.34 kg) for the 8-port EX-UM-8X8SFP
svg.data-airflow-cfm: fan 22 CFM, each power supply 7.5 CFM; 59 CFM total with two supplies (datasheet)
svg.data-psu-redundancy: N+0 or N+N; up to two supplies, one is enough for the chassis
svg.data-acoustic-noise: 39 dBA with a 350 W AC AFO supply; 41.2 dBA with a 550 W DC AFO supply (datasheet Table 3, ISO 7779 at 23 C)
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 45 C (32 to 113 F) for AFO models; 0 to 35 C for AFI models
svg.data-humidity: 10 to 85 percent noncondensing operating; 0 to 95 percent non-operating
svg.data-altitude: up to 3049 m operating (10,000 ft); 4877 m non-operating
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to 10 members; the two rear QSFP+ ports are Virtual Chassis ports by default, and the four built-in SFP+ ports cannot be Virtual Chassis ports
svg.data-poe: none - the 32-port switches have no Power over Ethernet
svg.data-macsec: IEEE 802.1AE on all Gigabit Ethernet and 10 Gigabit Ethernet ports
svg.data-uplink-module: one slot; 2-port 40-Gigabit EX-UM-2QSFP or 8-port 1/10-Gigabit SFP+ EX-UM-8X8SFP (neither is part of the shipping configuration)
svg.data-optics-sfp: LC SFP SX (multimode) and LX (single-mode), and 100BASE-FX and 1000BASE-T copper SFPs on the fixed 100/1000BASE-X ports (datasheet, Supported Optics and Ordering Information)
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: LC SFP+ SR, USR, LRM (multimode), LR, ER (single-mode) and DAC direct-attach copper (datasheet, Supported Optics)
svg.data-optics-qsfp: 40GbE QSFP+ SR4 (multimode) and DAC direct-attach copper (datasheet, Supported Optics)
svg.data-console: mini-USB on the front, RJ-45 console on the rear
svg.data-oob: MGMT RJ-45 with link activity and status lamps (rear)
svg.data-lcd: 2 lines of 16 characters with Menu and Enter buttons
svg.data-usb: one USB port on the rear
svg.data-nebs: GR-1089-CORE EMC and electrical safety for network telecommunications equipment (listed by the datasheet; no level stated)
svg.data-emc: FCC 47 CFR Part 15 Class A, EN 55022 Class A, ICES-003 Class A, VCCI Class A, AS/NZS CISPR 22 Class A, CISPR 22 Class A, EN 55024, EN 300386, CE
